identity.name: Git & GitHub
identity.description: Git plus GitHub's official CLI (gh). Settings here hold Berth's Git program and the accounts used for git push/pull and Discover; agents use gh to open PRs, watch CI checks and address review feedback without leaving Berth.

cli-help.notes: Flags in usage.md checked against `gh <cmd> --help` for pr create/checks/view/diff/comment, run view, issue view. install.sh asset names checked against the v2.102.0 release.
